context: Tests whether the agent writes user stories that follow the skill's Agile integration requirements: correct story format, Given-When-Then acceptance criteria, MoSCoW prioritization, INVEST-aligned stories, and DoR/DoD gate checklists. The agent should produce sprint-ready stories with all required metadata.

checklist.name: As-a/I-want/So-that format
checklist.description: Every user story uses the three-part structure: 'As a [role], I want to [action], So that [benefit]' — all three parts present on each story

checklist.name: Given-When-Then acceptance criteria
checklist.description: Each user story includes acceptance criteria written in Given-When-Then (Gherkin) format — at least one Given/When/Then block per story

checklist.name: MoSCoW priority labels
checklist.description: Story priority is expressed using MoSCoW labels (Must/Should/Could/Won't) — not numeric scores, T-shirt sizes, or other frameworks

checklist.name: Story ID assigned
checklist.description: Each user story has a unique, structured ID (e.g., US-001, STORY-001) — not just a title

checklist.name: DoR checklist present
checklist.description: Each user story includes a Definition of Ready (DoR) checklist with at least 2 items (e.g., criteria clear, testable, estimated)

checklist.name: DoD checklist present
checklist.description: Each user story includes a Definition of Done (DoD) checklist with at least 2 items (e.g., code complete, tests pass, reviewed)

checklist.name: Risk attribute on stories
checklist.description: Each user story includes an explicit Risk attribute (High/Medium/Low)

checklist.name: Dependencies listed
checklist.description: Each user story includes a Dependencies field (may be 'None' where applicable, but the field is present)

checklist.name: Story Points / estimate included
checklist.description: Each user story includes a story point estimate or sizing estimate

checklist.name: Backlog summary table
checklist.description: A backlog_summary.md file exists with a table listing at least Story ID, Title, and Priority for each story

checklist.name: At least 5 stories
checklist.description: The user_stories.md file contains at least 5 distinct user stories
